newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo sees ADR issue this month.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo sees ADR issue this month.

text.p: Russian regional utility Irkutskenergo expects to launch its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) later this month, a senior company official said on Friday.

Economics director Valentin Mezhevich told Reuters that Irkutskoye AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii (Irkutskenergo) was putting the final touches to its depositary agreement with the Bank of New York, to be sent to the bank early next week.
"We are in the final stage of preparations for the ADR issue. I believe the placement of ADRs will take place this month," Mezhevich said.
"The Bank of New York has reviewed the depositary agreement and suggested some changes. On Monday or Tuesday the final version will be sent to them."
Mezhevich said the recent rise in Irkutskenergo shares was due to the approaching ADR issue.
"We hope they will go to 20 cents this month. And that's a modest forecast. It's impossible for a company with a bigger installed capacity than Mosenergo to be so cheap," he said.
